summary: Your clinic has Google reviews, press logos and an expert team, but the page has dead treatment menus and a WhatsApp link that dials your landline.

findings.problem: The footer WhatsApp link points to tel:+44(0)2036955400, the landline, not the WhatsApp number +44 7401 163760.
findings.cost: A patient who taps to message gets a phone call instead and may give up.
findings.fix: A tested WhatsApp button on the correct number.

findings.problem: Injectables, Thread Lifting, Laser Treatments, Skin, Hair, Gynaecology and Body menu items link to #, and the same treatment appears under different URLs (/bbl-hero/, /bbl-heroic/).
findings.cost: A patient looking for a treatment hits a dead menu and Google sees duplicates.
findings.fix: Working menus and one page per treatment.

findings.problem: Leaked template text shows (Circle Text Configuration with Larger Font, Girl in a jacket), Trending appears five times, and several reviews appear to repeat word for word.
findings.cost: Repeats and leftover text make a premium brand look careless.
findings.fix: Clean templates and a single review wall.

findings.problem: No street address on the homepage, no before and after images, Book Now opens a popup with a 150 pound fee, and 45,000+ procedures has no source.
findings.cost: Patients cannot see where you are or what results to expect.
findings.fix: Address and map, captioned results and clear fee wording.

redesign: Working menus, a correct WhatsApp button and one page per treatment.
A clean review wall, results gallery and clear address and fee information.
